pages.title: Slime Hop
pages.text: Climb one layer per jump; a fall ends the run.

pages.title: How to play
pages.text: One stake funds the run. Start jumps one layer; after landing, continue or cash out. A fall breaks the ice and ends the entire run at zero.$(br2)Total multipliers, layers 1–10:$(br)1.2, 1.5, 2, 2.75, 4, 6, 10, 16, 25, 40.

pages.title: Event probabilities
pages.text: Single-jump chances to layers 1–5:$(br)80%, 75%, 70.588%, 66.667%, 63.158%.$(br2)Layers 6–10:$(br)60%, 57.143%, 54.545%, 52.174%, 50%.$(br2)These are conditional step chances after reaching the previous layer, not full-run probabilities.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.2; initial stake cap 10,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)At ×40, cash out. Leaving, disconnecting or unloading settles completed jumps.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
